data.question: Do pinned official Lean and Nanoda both accept six source-derived declarations that retain named universe parameters, symbolic max conversions and dependent Pi/imax formation?
data.versions: Lean4.34.1 ARM64; Nanoda3a24072; NDJSON3.1.0; compiled parser076e8e5; exact binary/library hashes in protocol.json.
data.commands: run_process.py matrix 300 python3 run_matrix.py; six cases x (lean --run Replay.lean INPUT; nanoda_bin CONFIG). Exact argv retained per cell; time/memory/cleanup controls in protocol.json.
data.sample: Exactly P1/P2 named parameter with let control; M1/M2 successor/max distribution and commutation; I1/I2 Pi/imax and equivalent max operand. All six expected ACCEPT before observation.
data.controls: Six positive source-derived expectations in three equivalent pairs. No intentionally invalid declaration, known fault, negative-control detection rate or independent holdout. M1/M2 require nonidentical symbolic max conversion; I1/I2 require Pi universe inference with parameter-right imax. Future negative controls require a separately selected item. Compare actual official parser output exactly to cases.json before treating its verdict as qualified. Nanoda raw constructors are source-bound and both checkers consume byte-identical files verified before and after execution. No runtime branch-coverage instrumentation: I2 tests preserved imax and equivalent max operand; no claim of forcing a particular imax case-split branch.
